lines.en: : Guh. Bring back the sun. One day of summer weather isn’t enough. I want more.
Niki was gone when I woke up.
I imagine it was a side effect of regret or something along those lines.
I can’t imagine it’s very nice to wake up next to me of all people- especially when I’ve hurt her as much as I have in the past.
Nothing happened, in case you were wondering.
I obviously tried to make things happen, but she wasn’t having any of it.
I guess she just wanted the company.
She kept my t-shirt, though, which is a surprisingly ex-girlfriend thing to do.
But I’m sure I’ll be seeing her again as it was one of my extra thick ones and I need it in order to survive the winter.
: You’re sure you have everything, Sensei?
: I’m missing a shirt, but that much is out of my control.
: I think I’m fine when it comes to everything else, though. I didn’t bring a lot.
: Would someone remind me again why we have to leave so early, though?
: Because we have[school], of course.
: Would someone also remind me why Touka is here?
: How rude.
: But since you are so insistent on knowing-
: I asked one time.
: Since you are so insistent, it is because I am still waiting to be thanked for enabling this vacation.
: You’re probably going to be waiting for a while, Touka. Sensei’s not very good at thanking people for the nice things they do for him.
: Lies. Thank you, Touka. I appreciate it.
: Hey! I helped, too! Where’s my “Thanks, Ayane! I love you!?”
: Somewhere else. I’ll give it to you later.
: Oh. Well...um...the pleasure has been all mine.
: And mine.
: But yeah...mostly Touka’s, I guess. Even if we didn’t use half of the rooms we paid for.
: Now that you’re done praising the people that aren’t me, we should probably get going. You wouldn’t want to miss[school], would you?
: Is that a real question? Of course I’d want to miss[school]. I hate[school].
: I have to...do stuff there.
: Probably even more today than usual, too.
: Yeah. Mondays suck.
: Wait...did you not hear?
: Hear what? I’ve been awake for like twenty minutes and you four are the only girls I’ve seen.
: Miss Watabe...
: Miss Watabe overdosed last night and had to be rushed to the hospital.
: What?
: Osako came bursting into our room asking for help in the middle of the night. I’m surprised you didn’t hear anything.
: Is she okay?
: Touka was able to arrange an ambulance right away and she’s stable now...but she’s going to be taking off of[school] for a little while so she can recover.
: I’m sure you could have arranged for a transport just as quickly as me. I just happened to have a phone nearby.
: What was she on?
: Does that really matter? Because it’s not something I really think any of us should be asking.
: No, it doesn’t matter I guess. I’m just a little confused.
: It could have been an accident...
: I mean, it probably was an accident.
: Miss Watabe is dark all the time, yeah. But...I don’t think she really means it when she says all that stuff about wanting to die.
: Perhaps we should make a “get well” card of some sort?
: When I fell off my horse in elementary[school], my class got together and made a card like that for me.
: I thought it was very sweet.
: Until I found out that none of them wanted to sign it and that they only did it because the teachers asked them to and oh good now I’m feeling sad.
: Whatever happened...I think we should just leave the two of them alone for a little while and let them work through it.
: It’s not really our place to...get involved, I don’t think.
: But, umm...
: On the bright side...Rin and Otoha are dating now?
: Oh, right. I forgot Rin was going to confess last night.
: Otoha really said yes?
: Yes, but...how did you know Rin was going to confess?
: The same reason I know Touka sleeps on a vibrating love hotel bed. I’m popular.
: It...It is a normal, circular bed with rapid sleep technology!
: Rapid what now?
: And what does my bed have to do with those two forming a relationship with one another?!
: Nothing, really. I just thought teasing you might cheer you up.
: It-
: Wait...it actually kind of did.
: Huh.
: Either way! Looks like the harem is down two more girls and I am one step closer to...totally not marrying you because you’re my [uncle]! And that would be like, so weird, right?!
: Unless...
: Aaaaaanyway, I’m cold.
: And everybody else already went back to the dorms to shower and get ready for[school], so we might as well join them.
: In the shower? Good plan. Let’s head out, team.
As you may have guessed, I’m not able to shower with any of them.
But Touka is the only one who winds up heading back to the dorms anyway.
Ayane and Maya return to the house with Ami and me because that’s where they left all of their stuff.
And since they’re [teenage]girls and it isn’t weird for them to bathe together or whatever, they decide to just save time by not adding an extra stop to the mix.
I’m sure they would have invited Touka as well if it weren’t for the fact that they’d have trouble fitting her breasts in the bath alongside them.
Sorry, Touka.
: Touka?...
: Sensei?...
: Where did everyone go?...
The same room as always.
I wonder how many times it’s been now. And how many more mornings I’ll get to watch the light creep through the blinds.
I hope it really does last forever.
Because even if this world isn't something I understand...or something Maya understands...
It’s my home now.
And sure, it can be pretty horrible at times with friends overdosing or having their hearts broken-
Actually, correction. Rin didn’t have her heart broken this time.
Good for her.
I can only imagine how Molly must be feeling, though.
I’ll have to check on her-
...soon.
: Don’t speak.
: Just let me have this.
: Please.
: Okay.
Remember the other morning when I told you that I’d find myself losing battle after battle soon enough?
Well-
I managed to win one in the end.
Maya leaves the room silently, without asking me to forget about this or...abstain from bringing it up to anyone else.
But I don’t think I will either way.
Just like I don’t think I’ll tell anyone about Niki showing up in my room last night to just...leave before sunrise without saying anything.
I have no reason to tell anyone at all about either of these things.
But it’s still only morning.
And even if everything is bright and beautiful now, it doesn’t mean it will be later.
The person I trust least of all is myself.
I don’t deserve any of this.
